description: This file contains Python code related to code generation for CUDA kernels using Cutlass. It defines classes and functions to generate Python code for handling tensor operations and codegen for CUTLASS-based GPU kernels, including configuration, code formatting, and IR translation.

classes.name: CutlassEVTOpsMixIn
classes.description: Mix-in class providing static methods for CUDA tensor operations such as multiplication, division, addition, and activation functions.

classes.name: MockCutlassHandler
classes.description: A passthrough handler for CUTLASS operations used for memory planning.

classes.name: CutlassEVTCodegen
classes.description: Main class for generating Python code for CUTLASS epilogue operations, including methods to assemble code, handle buffers, and manage indexing.

methods.name: tuple[list[str],dict[str,Any],str] scaled_mm_evt( scale_A_name: str, scale_B_name: str, bias_name: Optional[str], output_name: str )
methods.description: Function that generates a list of read names, a mapping of variable names to buffer names, and Python code for a scaled matrix multiplication event with optional bias.

methods.name: str _infix_bin_op(op: str, a: str, b: str)
methods.description: Static method that returns a string representing an infix binary operation.

methods.name: str _prefix_bin_op(op: str, a: str, b: str)
methods.description: Static method that returns a string representing a prefix binary operation.

methods.name: str _prefix_un_op(op: str, a: str)
methods.description: Static method that returns a string representing a prefix unary operation.

methods.name: str to_dtype( x: str, dtype: Any, src_dtype: Optional[torch.dtype] = None, use_compute_types: bool = False, )
methods.description: Method to convert a tensor expression to a specified data type; currently returns input string unmodified.

methods.name: str constant(value: Any, dtype: Any)
methods.description: Static method that should return a string representation of a constant value; not implemented.

methods.name: str mul(x0: str, x1: str)
methods.description: Method that returns a string representing multiplication of two expressions.

methods.name: str truediv(x0: str, x1: str)
methods.description: Method that returns a string representing division of two expressions.

methods.name: str ge(x0: str, x1: str)
methods.description: Method placeholder for greater-than-or-equal comparison; not implemented.

methods.name: str add(x0: str, x1: str)
methods.description: Method that returns a string representing addition of two expressions.

methods.name: str relu(x0: str)
methods.description: Method that returns a string representing the ReLU activation function.

methods.name: str sigmoid(x0: str)
methods.description: Method that returns a string representing the sigmoid activation function.

methods.name: str sub(x0: str, x1: str)
methods.description: Method that returns a string representing subtraction of two expressions.

methods.name: str tanh(x0: str)
methods.description: Method that returns a string representing the tanh activation function.

methods.name: str exp(x0: str)
methods.description: Method that returns a string representing the exponential function.

methods.name: _AssignmentFormatter
methods.description: Handler class for formatting assignment statements within the codegen context.

methods.name: tuple[list[str],list[str],dict[str,Any],str] ir_to_evt_python_code( cuda_template_node_name: str, epilogue_nodes: list[BaseSchedulerNode], removed_buffers: OrderedSet[str], )
methods.description: Static method that converts IR nodes into Python code for CUTLASS events, including reads, writes, renames, and code body.

methods.name: str get_value(self)
methods.description: Method that returns the generated code as a string.

methods.name: None finalize(self)
methods.description: Method that finalizes codegen, particularly renaming the last stored variable to D.

methods.name: Generator[None,Any,Any] set_cur_node(self, node: ComputedBuffer)
methods.description: Context manager to set the current IR node during code generation.

methods.name: dict[str,str] get_renames(self)
methods.description: Returns mapping of variable names to buffer names.

methods.name: list[str] get_reads(self)
methods.description: Returns list of variable names that are read.

methods.name: list[str] get_writes(self)
methods.description: Returns list of variable names that are written.

methods.name: str load(self, name: str, index: Any)
methods.description: Loads a variable, adding it to read set if not present, handling buffer indexing.

methods.name: None store( self, name: Any, index: Any = None, value: Any = None, mode: Any = None )
methods.description: Stores a value into a buffer variable, handling buffer name mapping and index checks.

methods.name: ComputedBuffer _get_cur_node(self)
methods.description: Returns the current IR node being processed.

methods.name: Sequence[sympy.Expr] get_index_vars(node: ComputedBuffer)
methods.description: Static method to extract index variables from a buffer node.

methods.name: Sequence[sympy.Expr] _get_current_index_vars(self)
methods.description: Returns index variables for the current node.

methods.name: None _check_indexing(self, name: str, index: sympy.Expr)
methods.description: Checks if indexing matches buffer layout and strides; raises if not supported.

methods.name: bool _stride_compatible( self, left: Iterable[sympy.Expr], right: Iterable[sympy.Expr] )
methods.description: Checks if stride patterns are compatible between layout and index strides.

methods.name: str _render_input_signature(self)
methods.description: Generates the input signature for the compiled function.

methods.name: str _render_return_statement(self)
methods.description: Generates the return statement referencing stored variables.

methods.name: str _tmp_var(self)
methods.description: Generates a temporary variable name for intermediate computations.
